tasks.question: How many customers do we have in each country?
tasks.reference: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY country
tasks.good:
```sql
SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;
```
Counts customers per country.
tasks.bad: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;

tasks.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
tasks.reference: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)
tasks.good:
```sql
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.id IS NULL;
```
Customers with no matching order row.

tasks.question: What is our total revenue from paid orders? Revenue is quantity times the product price.
tasks.reference: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid'
tasks.good:
```sql
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid';
```
tasks.bad:
```sql
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id;
```

tasks.question: What are the top 2 products by total quantity sold in paid orders? Show each product's name and quantity.
tasks.reference: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 2
tasks.good:
```sql
SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 2;
```

tasks.question: List every customer who signed up in 2026 with their number of orders, including customers with zero orders, ordered by customer name.
tasks.reference: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.signup_date >= '2026-01-01' AND c.signup_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.name
tasks.good:
```sql
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE strftime('%Y', c.signup_date) = '2026'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;
```
tasks.bad:
```sql
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE strftime('%Y', c.signup_date) = '2026'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;
```
